subject: Proposal: channel-billed procurement path for Valeo Health (invoice routing to marketplace)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@valeohealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: channel-billed procurement path for Valeo Health (invoice routing to marketplace)

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the time on Friday. Per our discussion, Valeo is a great candidate to move from direct invoicing to a channel-billed procurement flow (e.g., Azure Marketplace or AWS Marketplace), which should simplify your internal purchasing and allow you to consolidate cloud spend. To make the conversion low-friction, I attached a draft amendment that outlines:

- SKU mapping and equivalent pricing for the committed configuration
- Billing cadence (monthly invoice via marketplace vs. direct invoicing)
- Purchase order expectations and PO flow for reconciliation
- Short rollback window if the first invoice doesn't reconcile cleanly

High level benefits for Valeo:
- Single vendor invoice via your preferred marketplace (fewer GL lines)
- Same unit economics — we’ll preserve the agreed list price and committed discounts
- Faster procurement sign-off for teams that require marketplace billing

Can you confirm the procurement contact who must approve marketplace billing? Also, do you have a strict requirement for Azure Marketplace only, or would AWS Marketplace be acceptable if the SKU and invoice structure match your finance requirements?

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm procurement contact and channel preference
2) We send a brief legal amendment (attached) and a marketplace SKU crosswalk
3) You issue a PO referencing the marketplace invoice or we sign DocuSign to enable billing cutover

Attaching: redwood_marketplace_amendment_draft.docx

If useful, I can set up a 30-min call with our finance ops and Laura (legal) to walk the amendment.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0193
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@valeohealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@valeohealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: channel-billed procurement path for Valeo Health (invoice routing to marketplace)

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the summary and the draft. A few questions from procurement/finance before we proceed: 

1) Price parity: will the marketplace invoice show the same discount tiers and effective price as our existing direct contract? We can’t accept higher net spend simply because of channel fees.
2) Commitments: we currently have a 12-month committed consumption agreement. Does the marketplace flow require re-authoring the commitment or can we map the existing commitment to a marketplace SKU?
3) PO: our AP team prefers to issue a PO that references the marketplace invoice number (for reconciliation). Can Redwood accept a PO that references the marketplace invoice rather than a Redwood direct invoice?
4) SSO/Entitlements: any changes required on the SSO or entitlements side for our team once we flip billing?

I’m looping in Priya (finance) on the thread. I also attached our standard payment terms for reference.

On Tue, Nov 3, 2026 at 10:05 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Liam —
> 
> Thanks again for the time on Friday. Per our discussion...

Attachments: Valeo_Payment_Terms.pdf

Liam O'Connor

Valeo Health
liam.oconnor@valeohealth.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@valeohealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: channel-billed procurement path for Valeo Health (invoice routing to marketplace)

Liam —

Good questions; quick answers below and proposed action items. I copied Laura for legal and Grace from Customer Success to confirm entitlements/workflow impact.

1) Price parity: We will preserve the effective net price you have on file. The marketplace invoice will reflect the same SKU-level prices and discounts. Channel fees are absorbed by Redwood for this conversion — you will not see an uplift.

2) Commitments: We can map the existing 12-month commitment to a marketplace SKU via an amendment; no need to re-negotiate the commitment terms. The amendment (attached previous draft) includes language to keep the existing term and starts marketplace billing on the next invoice cycle.

3) PO: Yes, Redwood will accept a PO that references the marketplace invoice. Workflow we typically follow: you issue PO -> we enable marketplace invoicing for the account -> first marketplace invoice is generated and the PO number is attached for AP reconciliation.

4) SSO/Entitlements: No entitlements changes are required for users. The only operational change is the billing endpoint; our entitlements system will still honor the same seat counts and role assignments. Grace, can you confirm there are no feature-gating changes on your side?

Action items:
- Liam: confirm marketplace preference (Azure vs AWS) and send signed PO once you have internal sign-off
- Laura: prepare DocuSign amendment ready to sign (I’ve attached the draft again)
- Grace: validate entitlement mapping for marketplace SKU

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-8742

Thanks — I’ll stand up a 20-minute call if that helps finalize PO issuance.

Marcus Lin
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@valeohealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@valeohealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 17:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: channel-billed procurement path for Valeo Health (invoice routing to marketplace)

Marcus / Laura —

We’re aligned to proceed on Azure Marketplace. Priya confirmed the PO will be issued today referencing the marketplace invoice and our AP team is fine with the mapping you described. We also appreciate Redwood absorbing channel fees for the first quarter to make the transition smooth.

Attaching signed PO: Valeo_PO_2026.pdf. Please send the DocuSign amendment and the marketplace SKU crosswalk so our AP team can verify GL coding.
